title: Idempotency Key Deduplication on Master Block Order
precondition: Network timeout causes master trading GUI to retry order submission with same `Idempotency-Key`.
expected: Second request deduplicated at API gateway; single block executed; zero double-order fan-out.
coverage_note: Requires infrastructure hooks, a different account population, distributed nodes, gateway idempotency contract, or long-duration load tooling not supplied.
